name: gemini-tts
description: Generate read-aloud audio (text-to-speech) using Google Gemini 3.8 TTS. Auto-selects the model by purpose: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS for expressive narration and dialogue, Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS for long-form / bulk read-aloud. Auto-detects single-speaker narration vs 2-person multi-speaker dialogue from the input. Supports 30 prebuilt voices, structured style control and inline vocal tags, text or file input, and WAV output. Works with Gemini Developer API and Vertex AI.
